en: There is a broad variety of models you may
be using in your
systems, in your AI agents. For example, the
models by OpenAI or by Anthropic. And of
course, there are many other providers of AI
models too. There also are certain providers
that offer so-called open weights models,
which means
these are models which don't just run on
their servers, but which you in theory could
also run on your systems because the
weights, the results of the model training
are publicly available.
And with the right software like Ollama or
LM Studio or other software, you could
download and use those weights on your
machine to run the AI model on your machine.
Now,
you will still need the right hardware. And
for the best of the models, you most likely
won't have that hardware. But of course, you
could also rent a server in some data
center, a pretty beefy, well-equipped
server, and run a model there.
And it's It's just important to be aware of
the fact that there are these different
models, the closed models by OpenAI and
Anthropic, which only run on their servers,
which you can't even theoretically run on
your machine.
And then the open weight models, which are
just large language models like the ones by
OpenAI, but which can be run on any system
that has the right hardware.
